title: ODNI claim that Dylan Borland drew a sensor system

tellings.quote: directly from ODNI, is that Dylan Borland drew a fourth drawing of a sensor system.
>> Jeremy spoke about it. They created a fake force drawing and I have the text messages
tellings.difference: Borland tells it firsthand, calls the drawing fabricated and says he has text messages proving it.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same ODNI claim that Borland made a fourth drawing, which Corbell tells as a sensor-system drawing.

plain: Word came from the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the office that oversees US spy agencies, that a UFO whistleblower named Dylan Borland had drawn a fourth drawing, of a sensor system. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he heard this straight from that office. Borland himself tells it differently, saying the drawing was faked, tied to a report by the Pentagon's UFO office, and that he has text messages to prove it.
